feeds.title: NZ Lawyer
feeds.description: Receive the latest & breaking news, opinion, and analysis about New Zealand's legal landscape. NZ Lawyer is the leading independent news and information resource for the legal industry in New Zealand.

feeds.title: Pacific Legal Blog
feeds.description: Read blogs about New Zealand visas, immigration, and other interesting legal issues topics! Pacific Legal are immigration lawyers, providing their services across New Zealand to anyone requiring support with immigration law.

feeds.title: LawHawk Blog
feeds.description: Blog topics cover Legal Automation, Document Automation, Legal Technology, Practice of Law, and more. LawHawk are lawyers (but not a law firm) who mainly help other lawyers improve and automate their processes to save time and increase quality and compliance.

feeds.title: Media Law Journal
feeds.description: The blog features Articles about Media Law and Ethics in New Zealand. Media Law Journal is founded by Steven Price, who is a barrister, lecturer, and blogger specialising in media law, practising in Wellington.

feeds.title: Collins & May Law Blog
feeds.description: The blog features Articles on Employment Law, Estates, Wills, Commercial Property, and more. Collins & May Law is a Wellington-based law firm that practices in many areas of law with extensive experience in trusts, property, employment, relationship property, business, and litigation.

feeds.title: Community Law Waikato Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts on topics like Community Law, Employment rights, Family Violence, Legal Rights, and more. Community Law Waikato is one of many community law centres across Aotearoa New Zealand. The centres operate in 140 locations, providing legal help to more than 250 thousand people per year.

feeds.title: Criminal Law Casebook
feeds.description: Aimed at promoting the study of technical aspects of criminal law and procedure, this site considers selected cases from the top appeal courts of Australia, Canada, the UK, the USA, the European Court of Human Rights, and New Zealand.

feeds.title: Islamic Law Blog » New Zealand
feeds.description: The blog covers posts on Islamic law, law and society, Constitutional law, and more. SHARIAsource is a flagship research venture of the Program in Islamic Law at Harvard Law School.

feeds.title: Law for Change Blog
feeds.description: Features Articles on legal issues and laws in New Zealand. Law for Change is a nonprofit organisation that is dedicated to providing law students across the country with a space for them to pursue public interest law. We encourage the use of our members legal knowledge to help those in our surrounding communities, this is done through the volunteer opportunities we both provide and advertise for other organisations.

feeds.title: New Zealand Immigration Law » Resources
feeds.description: Our blog provides up to date Immigration news, information, and insights for migrants and employers to navigate the New Zealand immigration system. NZ Immigration Law provides practical expert advice on immigrating to NZ. We simplify the visa process and take the guesswork out of the procedure.

feeds.title: BuckettLaw
feeds.description: The blog focuses exclusively on Employment Law. BuckettLaw is a boutique law firm comprising of specialist employment lawyers, providing clients with timely and expert advice since 1998 and led by leading employment law expert Barbara Buckett.
